achievements.title: Smart India Hackathon 2025 - 1st Runner Up
achievements.description: CogniDetect is an AI-powered cognitive health screening platform designed for the early detection of potential dementia-related cognitive decline by analyzing speech patterns, cognitive assessment responses, eye movements, and behavioral indicators. It combines React, FastAPI, Python, AI/ML models, PostgreSQL, and Firebase Authentication to provide an accessible screening workflow and structured cognitive insights for users and healthcare professionals.
achievements.organizerVenue: The Ministry of Education, Government of India

achievements.title: Internal Smart India Hackathon 2026 - 2nd Runner Up
achievements.description: PharmaLoop AI is a smart, multi-role platform designed to improve coordination, transparency, and accountability in healthcare-related workflows. It brings users, service providers, and administrators together through a streamlined digital experience, with tracking, verification, and reward-based engagement.
achievements.organizerVenue: Anjuman-I-Islam's Kalsekar Technical Campus • New Panvel

achievements.title: Google Student Ambassador 2026
achievements.description: Selected as a Google Student Ambassador 2026, representing the student developer community and contributing to Google-led programs, learning initiatives, and technology-focused community activities. The role provides opportunities to engage with fellow students, promote technology awareness, and support knowledge sharing within the developer community.
